verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team chat workspace, so a compliance export of message history is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no workspace export feature, no machine-readable export format, and no policy-governed export of private conversations. What it does show is adjacent: agent history search, a moderation-focused admin API, open Nostr relay access for third-party clients, and self-hosted Postgres storage. None of these is the product's own export capability.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can export the full message history of my workspace in machine-readable formats, including private conversations where policy allows
